input_text: If we force an AI model to precisely predict the shape and position of every random water ripple, or every tiny dust particle, it is an impossible and completely meaningless task. Trying to compute the error, or pixel loss, on every single pixel generates a massive amount of noise. As a result, the model gets lost in a sea of chaotic data, instead of learning the higher level semantic structure of the action, such as the simple understanding that 'this is a boat, and it is moving forward'.
